data_ownership.retention: Retain migration history only after committed schema changes; fresh and upgraded inventories agree.
Preserve repository identity, tracked branch and metadata; update via admitted transaction.
Regenerate tracked code rows; retain synthetic/imported-document rows and remap dependent foreign keys coherently.
Regenerate code-derived definitions in stage; retained document-linked rows must remain referentially valid.
Retain document/history chunks and stable IDs; regenerate only chunker-owned code rows.
Retain admitted imported-document mappings; stage new mappings with exact profile and collection generation.
Retain outstanding deletion debt across rebuild/crash; clear only acknowledged remote deletes.
Retain imported summaries and valid unchanged-content/profile summaries; invalidate derived summaries on content/profile drift.
Rebuild imports for admitted code files; preserve links for retained rows where present.
Rebuild references with valid file/symbol foreign keys; never publish dangling references.
Reconstruct FTS from the staged authoritative symbols; do not copy SQLite-managed FTS shadow internals.
Rebuild from all retained and newly derived chunks so imported content remains searchable.
Rebuild from final staged symbol IDs.
Retain compatible imported embeddings; derive code embeddings under frozen per-batch provenance.
Discard at generation/profile change; never expose a prior generation's query result.
Reuse only exact content/parser identity, otherwise discard.
Retain truthful successful/failed upgrade records; no skipped-tail success acknowledgement.
Preserve operator settings and publish generation/profile identity atomically with provenance.
Retain move lineage and repository relationships across replacement.

invariants.generation_binding: One durable repository identity plus an opaque generation identifier binds SQLite file identity, indexed commit/branch, chunk scheme, vector collection and embedding profile. No new public readiness vocabulary.
invariants.registry_mutation: Under a process-shared lock reload disk, apply explicit field update or tombstone deletion, write/fsync/replace and fsync parent, then update local view. Failed persistence raises; stale full snapshots never merge away newer fields.
invariants.registry_visibility: Every read checks durable revision/file identity. Query-triggered writes use the same mutation protocol. Successful registration/removal is visible to another process and watcher.
invariants.writer_admission: One cross-process writer per repository. Hold admission across stage verification and durable generation publication; do not use thread-only exclusion.
invariants.reader_admission: Resolve live Git identity and durable generation before borrowing a handle. Recheck generation before emitting results. On changes re-resolve or return index_unavailable/native_search; caches and watchers use the same binding.
invariants.retained_data: Copy retained rows and relationships into the stage before rebuilding derived rows. Keep synthetic document/history identity and cleanup debt. FTS shadow tables are SQLite-managed, not separately copied.
invariants.publication: Fence readiness before mutation; stage SQLite and semantic effects separately; only admit a complete verified generation. Success metadata follows durable publication, never the reverse.
invariants.rollback: Before admission, preserve old coherent generation or explicit unavailable state. After admission, retain old physical resources until all old borrowers release them. Never unlink active SQLite sidecars or break Qdrant locks.
invariants.cleanup_debt: Persist remote deletion intents before forgetting mappings; successful acknowledged remote cleanup retires only its own intents. Retry is idempotent.
invariants.metadata_failures: Disk write/replace/fsync failures must propagate and leave a restart-visible pending/unavailable fence; no success acknowledgement on merely in-memory provenance.
invariants.pool_lifetime: Closing prevents admission, wakes queued borrowers, drains outstanding borrowers, and rejects/disposes late-created connections.
invariants.shared_file_schedule: Sequential manual phases. STATE owns registry/pools/generation changes first; SAFETY owns logging/metrics/lifecycle next; DATA owns query/semantic changes last. multi_repo_manager.py, gateway.py, stdio_runner.py, watcher_multi_repo.py, dispatcher_enhanced.py and sqlite_store.py are never concurrent writer paths.

policies.support: Preserve existing SUPPORT_MATRIX tiers. Initial acceptance Linux/Python 3.12 does not prove all >=3.12/platform claims; DIST records explicit evidence and requests owner amendment before narrowing published support.
policies.ignore_and_edits: Automatic indexing uses tracked/default-branch committed content only. Respect Git nested excludes/negations before traversal/embedding. Dirty working-tree edits are not silently admitted; refuse stale generations. Lost-event recovery reconciles committed create/modify/delete/rename.

pmcp.configuration_channel: .mcp.json mcpServers entry env, not manifest overlay env
pmcp.acceptance: Two unrelated synthetic repos and one sibling worktree; connect, query, refuse, reindex, restart, signal/EOF/inflight cleanup, reconnect and reprovision.

qdrant.server_identity: Resolve/pin the local disposable server image/digest in DATA; never use the fleet index.

signer.proposal: Operator-dispatched GitHub OIDC attestation workflow; pinned actions/attest plus gh attestation verify, exact expected producer repository/workflow/subject digest. Local build provenance is stated honestly; a signing job must not claim it performed a local build.
signer.scope: Synthetic public fixture and approved digest/predicate only. No private source, index archive or secret uploads. Future private-repo sharing requires its own approved trust/privacy contract.

pilot.corpus: Synthetic temporary Git repos only; no fleet index
pilot.endpoint_identity: Revalidate endpoint/model/revision before PILOT; do not infer identity from model name or assume old reachability reports remain current.
pilot.budget_admission: Use endpoint-compatible tokenizer, or a conservative UTF-8-byte upper bound before every request including retries. Dry-run estimates and remaining quota precede admission.
pilot.evidence: Measure repeated warm queries under indexing contention with an explicit sample count and resource/time receipts; numbers are targets, not results.

policies.metrics: Loopback/disabled by default; remote exposure requires durable auth. Concurrent processes must not silently bind the same exporter port.
policies.http: Secondary local ephemeral admin only; no multi-tenant/shared HTTP support claim; rate limiting trusts only configured proxy peers.
policies.sandbox: Defense-in-depth for supported plugin APIs; do not claim hostile-plugin OS containment.
policies.ci: Local agent-fast/agent-gate/agent-full and explicit fail-closed offload; no new routine hosted CI or automatic inference.
policies.recovery: PREP must hand SHIP an owner-approved recovery policy before dispatch. Published-but-unaccepted remains blocked; preserve artifacts and evidence, no blind retry/yank/delete.

evidence_schema.long_proofs: Separate named nodes and individual timeout/partial result receipts; no opaque aggregate success.
